entities.title: Rust workspace
entities.summary: The Cargo workspace of the four Rust tools: zazzled, agent-fs, fix-network and free-disk-space.
entities.purpose: Holds one crate per tool and what they share: the workspace's edition, minimum Rust version and license, the release profile (link-time optimization, stripped symbols, one codegen unit), one Cargo.lock, the formatting rules and style.md, the Rust rules for agents.
boundaries: The crates share settings, not code: none depends on another.
Build output in target/ is never committed.
